content:
ajay: heads up — seit tonight we've been seeing sustained 99th tail spikes from us-west1 GPU hosts, 40ms -> ~420ms on generation routes. graph: https://grafana/redwood/shot/xyz :fire:

sophie: noticed same, started at ~02:10 UTC. noisy pattern looks like long KV regen + heavy prep jobs from a single tenant.

maria: which tenant? can we pin it down to a query set or job type?

ajay: initial signal points to tenant 'search-saas-prod' — lots of batched token prep jobs (large seq, repeated prefixes). KV cache eviction rate shot up 8x.

lee: can we soft-quarantine them? i.e. move to a fractional dedicated slice or apply QoS tag + egress throttle for 30m? cheaper than full carveout.

ajay: thinking: 1) apply qos:low to that tenant's routes 2) provision 4-slot fractional dedicated slice in usw1 for 1h 3) enable prefix-KV pinning on their warm pool

ops-runner: creating incident and a quick runbook step now. incident created: INC-20240318-421. infra-bot will post allocation status.

infra-bot: alloc request submitted: `allocctl carveout --region=us-west1 --slots=4 --ttl=1h --reason=\"KV thrash mitigation\"` -> alloc-id: alloc-0a9c.

sophie: for the QoS route, we can set token-rate-limit at proxy layer: `proxyctl set-rate --tenant=search-saas-prod --qps=10` (temporary). also consider lowering batch size on their preproc jobs — cc eng-ml.

maria: cost: reserved fractional slice ~ $6/hr (4 gpus/slot pro-rated) vs perf hit on other tenants. if we carveout, need approval from product + finance for cross-tenant SLA impact.

lee: can we do a cheaper fallback: route heavy prep requests to quantized variant (gpt-small-q4) with automatic reroute? would reduce GPU time and KV pressure. but may change outputs. need quick eval.

ajay: agreed — plan A (fast): qos + rate-limit + alloc fractional slice (1h) + pin KV. Plan B (if persists): canary routing to quantized model + escalate to dedicated 12h carveout.

maria: steps assigned: ajay (apply qos + pin), sophie (rate-limit + monitor dashboards), lee (prepare quantized model endpoint and eval prompt set), ops-runner (standby to extend alloc).

ajay: commands I'm running now:
```
# pin prefix for tenant
kvctl pin-prefix --tenant=search-saas-prod --prefix=\"/prep/\" --ttl=1h
# temporary rate limit
proxyctl set-rate --tenant=search-saas-prod --qps=10
```

sophie: monitoring metrics: watch 99p latency, kv-evict/sec, host-gpu-util, egress-by-tenant. will post updates every 5m.

lee: if we see >2% error bump or no latency improvement in 15m, we'll flip to Plan B canary (10% traffic).

maria: FYI finance ok with 1h carveouts for ops mitigation, escalate if >3h.

ajay: update 02:28 UTC — alloc 0a9c active, pin successful. early signal: 99p down from 420ms -> ~220ms. continuing to monitor.

ops-runner: logged check-in: 02:35 UTC — no deploys, no other alerts.

sophie: 02:40 UTC — 99p ~150ms and KV-evict/sec dropped 65%. keeping qos for now.

maria: good. file a postmortem note and add 'prep-job' to tenant onboarding docs: guidance on batch sizes and kv-friendly prefixes.

lee: capture cost delta and timeline for the RCA. i'll start a small playbook diff for next time (auto soft-quarantine when kv-evict>threshold).

ajay: thanks all. will close incident after 30m stable. :thumbsup:
